selected_bottleneck: run-list-durable-id-binding-integrity（运行列表持久化 ID 绑定完整性）
selected_problem: Fresh canonical main made RunStore.get verify requested runId against the durable document body, but RunStore.list still bypassed get and parsed each JSON file directly. A single mismatched body id could therefore still appear in listing/audit surfaces even though direct reads now rejected it.（最新主分支已让 RunStore.get 校验请求 runId 与持久化文档内部 id，但 RunStore.list 仍绕过 get 直接解析 JSON；因此同一身份裂缝仍可通过列表/审计入口暴露，形成读取路径不一致。）
decision_basis: The fresh main already defines get() as the canonical durable identity boundary; routing list entries through get reuses that existing boundary instead of adding new architecture.（最新主分支已经把 get() 定义为持久化身份边界；让 list 复用 get 只是统一现有入口，不引入新架构。）

A bounded real-file replay directly reproduced the bypass: the pre-fix list returned a forged in-document id from a file whose filename selected a different run id.（有界真实文件重放直接复现：修复前 list 会返回内部伪造 id，虽然文件名选择的是另一个 run id。）
changes: Make RunStore.list derive each durable run id from the filename and load it through RunStore.get, inheriting RUN_ID_MISMATCH fail-closed behavior.（RunStore.list 从文件名推导 run id 并通过 RunStore.get 加载，从而继承 RUN_ID_MISMATCH 的失败关闭行为。）
Add regressions proving forged list entries fail closed while intact runs remain listable in updatedAt order.（新增回归，证明伪造列表条目失败关闭，同时正常运行仍按 updatedAt 顺序列出。）
